$comment: Shared corpus — quilltap-v5 copies this file verbatim and asserts the same outputs. `expect` is a PREFIX of the result: assert expect equals result.slice(0, expect.length). Fix the port, not the vectors.

cases.invariant: Exact shortcode outranks shortcode-prefix; ties fall in Unicode presentation order.
An underscore folds to a space, so the query reaches the CLDR name.
A hyphen folds exactly as an underscore does.
The query is case-folded before matching.
An empty query is presentation order — the picker's initial grid.
Shortcodes that are not alphabetic are still searchable.
A github-preset shortcode that is nothing like the CLDR name still resolves.
Name-prefix bucket, tie-broken by Unicode order rather than insertion order.
Word-start matching reaches past the name's first word.
A query that matches nothing returns nothing — never the whole set.
